title: One new planar Dy4 compound: Synthesis, structure and its magnetic dynamics behaviors

material_class.structural_family: rhombus-shaped tetranuclear Dy4 based on two μ3-OH-capped Dy3 triangles

synthesis.procedure: Compound 1 was obtained by reaction of Dy(dppd)3·6H2O (0.02 mmol) and HL (0.02 mmol) in a mixed solvent of 15 mL acetonitrile and 5 mL CH2Cl2. The yellow solution was stirred at room temperature for 3 h, filtered, and left unperturbed to evaporate slowly. Yellow block-shaped crystals suitable for single-crystal X-ray diffraction were isolated after 5 days.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution self-assembly with stirring, filtration, and slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After filtration, the solution was left unperturbed to evaporate slowly; yellow block-shaped crystals formed after 5 days.

properties.summary: Solid-state photoluminescence of 1 at room temperature (λex = 290 nm) shows characteristic Dy3+ emission at 480, 574 and 621 nm. DC magnetism indicates χMT = 56.53 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, remaining nearly constant to 100 K then decreasing and rising again to 40.19 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, with Curie–Weiss parameters C = 56.79 cm3 K mol−1 and θ = 1.07 K consistent with weak intramolecular ferromagnetic coupling plus anisotropy. Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility shows frequency-dependent χ″ peaks (8–13 K, 311–2311 Hz) and SMM behavior; Arrhenius fitting above 10 K gives Ueff = 62.36 K and τ0 = 3.98 × 10−7 s, while Cole–Cole α = 0.21–0.57 indicates a broad relaxation-time distribution and a low-T tail suggests QTM.
